verdict.rationale: Lithic's Auth Rules v2 engine lets users define rules on attributes like MCC, country, currency, and risk score at program, account, or card level. Those rules automatically make decisions across several event streams: card authorizations, 3DS, tokenization, and ACH receipts. Shadow mode and backtesting support safe rollout, and the MCP server lets an AI assistant configure these rules directly. Missing for 10: rule actions are limited to authorization decisioning, so arbitrary follow-on actions require webhooks plus your own code (or ASA); no rule-action types beyond approve/decline are documented; no independent or hands-on corroboration.
